_comment: Gemini text-to-speech casting (tools/assets/voices/gemini.py). Each line is sent as a short audio profile, director's notes (style, pace) and the transcript, kept apart: a bare 'Say X:' cue gets read aloud on short lines. The faction treatment (radio, synthetic, chorus) from build.py goes on top.

holdout.profile: Captain Varga, a tough, tired woman leading the last human resistance, speaking to her troops by radio.
holdout.style: grim, firm and steady; dry, never theatrical

halcyon.profile: HALCYON, a planetary AI, and WREN, one of its processes: a machine reporting.
halcyon.style: flat, precise and calm; no emotion

choir.profile: The Cantor, voice of an ancient crystal people who were a song before they were stone.
choir.style: soft, ancient and sorrowful, a little otherworldly

holdout.profile: A gruff human radio operator calling out battle reports.

halcyon.profile: A machine announcer: system notifications in a war.

choir.profile: The voice of a crystal people in battle.
